purpose: Compare bounded 5-node Case 1 candidates and fleet sizes using the same pooled 50 seeds.
answer_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 with LF line endings as stored in Git.
aggregation: Pool completed pickups after warmup across the entire 50-seed batch, then compute cost once with a floor-index urgent P95. Null cost when any seed is rejected.

D.method: Cross one new child below the near rule with one new child below the far rule.

YB.method: Enumerate all five-node rooted ancestor-closed subtrees, preserving rules and renumbering node IDs.

TEAM.method: Enumerate all five-node rooted ancestor-closed subtrees, preserving rules and renumbering node IDs.

KMJ.method: Check all six root-connected five-node prunings of the late-shared 9-node answer. Reuse identical decision rules after testing threshold equivalence on Case 1 feasible distances.

team_changes.jsm: New records cover cases other than Case 1.

reuse.matches: No matching completed batch for the selected 5-node candidates.

raw_logs: Unmodified evaluator stdout. The trace contains dispatch count and SHA-256, plus rejected seed IDs.
